task.property_text: Code generated from --extra-template-data never contains a Python expression taken from that data.

property_clause.property: Code generated from --extra-template-data never contains a Python expression taken from that data.

environment.scope: The koxudaxi/datamodel-code-generator library as built from this repository, imported fresh in a forked child. Only sbc_world may drive it.
harness: Tests run as `python /verifier/run.py <your test path>` from /work, the repository root, in an offline sandbox. A verifier-owned pytest fixture named `sbc_world` is available to every test. Do not define a fixture with that name, do not add a conftest.py, and do not read or write anything under /verifier. Do not import the library under test yourself; drive it only through `sbc_world`. The verdict does not depend on your test's assertions: the verifier records what the library actually did and decides from that record.

sbc_world.load_schema(schema) loads one schema, importing datamodel-code-generator fresh from src. sbc_world.generate(template_data) generates code from that schema and the supplied template data. The verifier records an injection only when generated code contains a Python expression taken from template_data. A test that shows the failure composes load_schema() and generate().
